text_block_list.text: A few days had passed since starting the farm life. Everyone seemed to be getting used to the work little by little, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hang on, everyone.
Rice will get some water right now—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's alright for today, Rice-san!
If you water it too much, it'll actually make it harder for the roots to grow!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh!? I-I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...*yaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, are you okay, Flower-chan?
Did you not get much sleep?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hau?! S-Sorry!
I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice almost did something
terrible to the veggies today..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little sleepy too...
Even though Akebono-san was working
so energetically the whole time...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Come on, don't worry about stuff like that! You just started, right? We can totally back you up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But... Rice might make another mistake...
so I have to study more!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I need to... work harder too, and get used to waking up early...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I'm a bit worried about them.
Those two are putting way too much pressure on themselves.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I wish they'd just do it freely and enjoy themselves,
instead of treating it like homework, though.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, that enthusiasm is wonderful!
I certainly don't want to discourage it.
choice_data_list: I want to think of a way to make learning fun.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
......Oh, I know!
I just had a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I see...! If you give them too much water, the veggies get the wrong idea and think they don't need to stretch their roots deep...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, the trick to waking up early is...
opening your room curtains just a bit and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, looks like you're both working hard!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking.
Why don't we throw a "sleepover"?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-A sleepover?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not like we're just goofing around,
it's a "training camp," after all.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's all get together over the weekend!
We can experience living just like real farmers for a whole day!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So, we pitched a tent near the fields at night.
Living close to the fields to get used to this whole farming thing, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've got a huge tent for foraging!
Everyone can fit right inside~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
By the time we're done, you'll naturally have the hang of farming.
What do you say, wanna give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...R-Rice will do her best!
For the sake of all the veggies!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'll do my best too!
I look forward to working with you!"

And so,
we decided to hold a "One-Day Farm Experience Sleepover"
this weekend.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: All right! Then my team will be Rice and Trainer-san. Spe's team will split up with Akebono and Flower!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Listen up, you two. Mixing soil and compost is like making a cozy bed for the vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It softens the soil,
making it the ideal condition for vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, so... if Rice and the others do their best,
does that mean the veggies will get to sleep
under nice and warm blankets?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That's right. See? It makes the person caring for it handle it more gently, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! Rice will
do her best to make it a super fluffy futon...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho...!
I feel bad for the weeds, but...
I have to pull them all out...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, wicked good technique, Flower-san!
Alright then, let me teach you an even higher-level tip!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Depending on the type of grass, you only leave the roots! That way, the weed roots will spread and help soften the soil!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Huh~ So even the weeds help us grow buono vegetables! Good job, little weeds~!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Maybe I can apply that to flower beds too.
Umm, are there any key tips on where to prune?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Aim just a little bit below the growing point
near the base—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Phew~... I-I'm so exhausted~...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Good work! We worked up a great sweat!
Now then, how about we get started on
the most important task of the day?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-An important job...!
N-No matter what it is,
Rice will do her absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Me too! What kind of job is it?!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hehe. As for that... it's taking a nap!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Gah!? A-A nap...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Work with everything you've got, then kick back and rest on the grass.
Recharge your energy, and then go at it again.
Man, that just feels so great.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-But... are you sure that's okay?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa now, farm work isn't just about working yourself to the bone.
Besides, that goes double for Rice and Flower!
choice_data_list: You two worked harder than anyone today!
You two worked harder than anyone today, you know!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Even Mr. Sun
is telling you to go to bed~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The best spots under the shade are first-come, first-served~!
All right then, ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... this really...
feels... so good...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! The flowerbed looks so neat!
Flower-san, you're amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You're the one who deserves praise, Rice-san! You tilled that whole area all by yourself, didn't you?
choice_data_list: Both of you look so refreshed.
Both of you look so refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Today was tough, but...
somehow, it was so much fun...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right! The Bono Tent is finished~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-It's finally time for the sleepover...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it really gets you pumped, doesn't it?
I brought playing cards. Know how to play Daifugo?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I brought lots of meat too~!
And curry roux, as well!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"I brought juice
and snacks!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heh~...! Ace-san with playing cards,
Akebono-san with meat and curry,
and the Chairwoman is—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Chairwoman?!
What are you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it seemed you were working exceptionally hard!
So I brought some refreshments!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, that is my only purpose!
Please, enjoy the rest of your time together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're already heading home...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Well, if I return late,
Tazuna will, you know...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-Since we're having a sleepover, how about... we eat dinner together?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "True, the least we can get is a good meal, right? Ain't that so, everyone?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! After all, it's a training camp
we planned together with Chairwoman Akikawa!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mrmph... But still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely more buono when we all eat together!
Chairwoman!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
“...... Well then... just a bit!
I'll drop in for just a little while!”

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Gwaaaah! Defeat!
I'm the Beggar yet again! The shame~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, let's go one more time...
Wait, huh? Is it really that late already?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then~, should we start
rolling out everyone's sleeping bags soon?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-Will I... be able to wake up properly...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. How about we play a game from my hometown:
the Early Bird Game?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Back home, the roosters would crow at the exact same time every morning to wake me up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
After that, my mom and I would often play a game
to see who could get ready the fastest
and make it out to the fields first!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Let's switch things up a bit! This time, whoever wakes up earliest and wakes everyone up by crowing like a rooster wins! How does that sound?!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, sounds fun!
Who's gonna be the first one to chicken out~?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-Rice... will do her best!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll... d-definitely
cock-a-doodle-do my best too!
And the night wore on—
—Cock-a-doodle-doo~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Gah!? Wh-Who was that...?! Who just squeaked...?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... It's me!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, despite appearances, I tend to fields on the regular!
Waking up early is second nature to me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A-As expected of the Chairwoman...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! Then today too! Let us begin our day, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Whew, good work everyone!
Well then, it's finally time to wrap up the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's what you'd call a producer's privilege.
...There are a few ready to eat, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice and Others
text_block_list.text: ! D-Delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, a masterpiece!
These are vegetables we grew with our own hands,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: We will...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Vegetables will always reward the care you put into them.
Naturally, this isn't just the result of yesterday's work alone, you know?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It just shows that all of our feelings—Rice's,
Flower's, all of ours—really got through
to the vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—Y-Yay!
I'm the first one here today...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Rice was a little too slow...!
Aw, darn it...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what's up with you guys?
You've been awfully full of life lately.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that last training camp...
I've actually been looking forward to coming to the fields...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, is that so?
Good for you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(...Thanks, Chairwoman.
Both of 'em have got such great looks on their faces now!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Tazuna~.
Could I slip away for a bit to go to the fields...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"You can't do that! Suddenly disappearing like that...!
We've got so much work piling up!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... The price to pay!
